column5: Afganistan fue un enclave turbulento para los britanicos en el Gran Juego frente al Imperio ruso durante el siglo XIX. Cada tentativa de someter el territorio desato una feroz resistencia afgana. Tras la segunda guerra anglo-afgana en 1880, el emir cedio finalmente el control de la politica exterior a Gran Bretana.

column2: Afghanistan was always a troubled region for the British to maintain control of. An important part of the 'Great Game' between the British Empire and the Russian Czars during the 19th century, every attempt to fully subdue the country ran into fierce resistance. By 1880, however, after the Second Anglo-Afghan war, the emir of Afghanistan finally agreed to allow British control over the country's foreign affairs. But following the Great War, the Afghani emir was assassinated and his son launched yet another war against Britain until the war-weary British agreed to fully withdraw from the country. By 1921 a cease-fire was finally signed granting Afghanistan complete independence. By 1923, a constitution was drawn up and the long process of modernization began....perhaps a bit too quickly. The newly crowned King was deposed by a revolt from Afghani tribesman angry at his attempts to do away with centuries old traditions, forcing him into exile by the end of the 1920's. He was replaced by King Nadir Shah, who kept his continuing reforms to a more acceptable pace. The outbreak of war has affected Afghanistan very little, so far. There is no sign yet of a danger to the country, and if the leaders have their way that will continue.
column5: Tras la tercera guerra anglo-afgana, el tratado de 1921 reconocio la plena independencia afgana. Las reformas modernizadoras provocaron una rebelion tribal tradicionalista que forzo el exilio del rey a finales de los anos 20. Bajo Nadir Sha y su sucesor, las reformas prosiguieron de forma prudente. El nuevo conflicto mundial no afecta por ahora la precaria estabilidad de la nacion.

column2: Afghanistan has guarded its neutrality fiercely, but now it finds itself between two warring juggernauts. Can Afghanistan guard its independence - or will it be drawn into the maelstrom of war?
column5: Afganistan defendio su neutralidad con firmeza durante la guerra, pero ahora queda encajonado entre dos bloques rivales. ¿Podra el reino preservar su soberania y evitar ser arrastrado al torbellino bélico internacional?

column5: Tras obtener la independencia frente a Gran Bretana en 1921, las apresuradas reformas provocaron una rebelion tribal a finales de la decada. Tras el asesinato de Nadir Sha, su joven sucesor Zahir Sha mantiene un cauteloso rumbo reformista en 1936. Aunque persisten tensiones entre jefes clánicos, el reino preserva su precaria paz interna en el Asia central.

column2: In 15th century, Albanian national hero Skanderbeg fought back the Turkish invaders. After his death however and the fall of Krujas and Shkodra the country came under four centuries of foreign rule. Large numbers of the population converted to Islam in the 16th and 17th century, allowing them to rise into the highest offices - eleven Grand Veziers came from Albania, and Mohammed Ali founded a dynasty in Egypt 1805. The Islamisation brought support for the resistance against Serbs and Greek as well as against the Ottoman rule itself. Only at the end of the 19th century the national renaissance began with the founding of the League of Prizren. During the First Balkans War in 1912 the Albanian national congress in Vlore declared the country's independence, which was accepted by the major powers in 1913 upon the condition that Wilhelms of Wied would be accepted as Prince.
column5: Tras cuatro siglos de dominio otomano y una prolongada resistencia armada, el renacimiento nacional albanes culmino con la Liga de Prizren y la proclamacion de independencia en Vlore durante la primera guerra balcanica de 1912. Las grandes potencias reconocieron el nuevo estado en 1913 bajo la condicion de aceptar al principe aleman Guillermo de Wied al frente del principado.

column2: Between 1941 and 1944, communist partisans and nationalist guerrillas fought Italian and German occupation forces, and more often each other, in a brutal struggle to take control of Albania. Backed by Yugoslavia's communists and armed with British and United States weaponry, Albania's partisans defeated the nationalists in a civil war fought between Italy's capitulation in September 1943 and the withdrawal of German forces from Albania in late 1944. By early 1945, the communists had consolidated their power with the backing of the Red Army. Now Albania is subservient to both Yugoslavia and the Soviet Union. What role will Albania play in the titanic struggle between east and west?
column5: Entre 1941 y 1944, partisanos comunistas y guerrillas nacionalistas combatieron a las fuerzas de ocupacion del Eje y libraron una dura guerra civil. Apoyados por los partisanos yugoslavos y armamento aliado, los comunistas derrotaron al Balli Kombetar y tomaron el poder en 1945 bajo la orbita de Moscu y Belgrado, quedando alineados en el bloque socialista.

During the First Balkans War in 1912 the Albanian national congress in Vlore declared the country's independence, which was accepted by the major powers in 1913 upon the condition that Wilhelms of Wied would be accepted as Prince. The short lived Principality Albania was occupied by the Middle Powers during World War One before it was conquered by Italy. After the war the leader of the Democratic Party, Bishop Fan Noli, faced the ruling conservatives under Ahmed Zogu. After a democratic interlude in 1924, Zogu eventually prevailed with aid from Yugoslavia and White Guards from Russia. He became president in 1925 and proclaimed himself king in 1928.
column5: Tras independizarse en 1912, Albania sufrio ocupaciones durante la Gran Guerra y gran inestabilidad politica. El obispo Fan Noli lidero un breve gobierno democratico en 1924, pero Ahmed Zogu tomo el poder con respaldo yugoslavo. Zogu se proclamo rey en 1928 como Zog I, instaurando un regimen autoritario dependiente en lo financiero y militar de la influencia expansionista italiana.

column2: In 1880 Argentina owned large areas suitable for their prime agricultural products: cattle and wheat. More workers were needed, increasing the numbe of immigrants. Financial capital, however, was largely controlled by the British who invested in infrastructure, controlled most banks and trade businesses, and that capital soon made Argentina the leading exporter of beef and wheat in the world. In the wake of this development an urban middle class formed as well as an industrial workers' class. Both called for more representation in politics to be achieved through changes to the electoral system. The radical UCR (Unión Civica Radical), founded in 1889, fought for those goals and came strong out of the reform of the electoral system which the conservative president Roque Sáenz Pena pushed through in 1912.
column5: Hacia 1880, Argentina consolido su modelo agroexportador basado en la carne y el grano, atrayendo capitales britanicos y una masiva inmigracion europea. El auge economico propicio el surgimiento de una clase media urbana y un proletariado que exigian reformas. La ley Saenz Pena de 1912 establecio el voto secreto y obligatorio, fortaleciendo la representacion politica de la opositora UCR.

column2: In 1880 Argentina owned large areas suitable for their prime agricultural products: cattle and wheat. More workers were needed, increasing the numbe of immigrants. In 1916 the first universal elections were held in which Hipólito Irigoyen of the UCR won. For the first time the middle classes had politcal influence. In foreign politics Argentina steered a course of neutrality while social legislature was to take away some negative effects of the wave of industrialization in the country. The period of economic rise and the second presidence of Irigoyen was ended abruptly with the Great Depression 1929/30. Conservative politicians and generals claimed the presidency after a military coup, but none of them could overcome the social tensions.
column5: La apertura democratica de 1912 llevo a la presidencia al radical Hipolito Yrigoyen en 1916. Pese al crecimiento y la neutralidad exterior, la Gran Depresion colapso las exportaciones y propicio el golpe militar de 1930. El regimen conservador fraudulento de la Decada Infame asumio el gobierno, debiendo gestionar la industrializacion interna y las graves tensiones sindicales.

column2: Armenia was the first country in the world to adopt Christianity as its state religion, and the Armenian people have clung to that religion despite centuries of rule by Muslim powers. In 1553, the Kingdom of Armenia was conquered and split between the Ottoman Empire and Persia. It has remained divided ever since, although the Persian half was gradually absorbed by Russia during the period 1801-28. The late 19th century saw the rebirth of Armenian nationalism, and the desire to form a new Armenian State. The collapse of Tsarist rule and rise to power of the Bolsheviks provided the opportunity desired, at least in the part of Armenia formerly under Russian rule. In the Ottoman Empire, Armenians remain a minority, subject to increasingly brutal and murderous oppression by a government that regards them as the enemy within. Faced by this threat to the south, the turmoil of the Russian Civil War to the north, and neighbours who might prove either friends or foes, Armenia must steer a perilous course to preserve her independence.
column5: Dividida historicamente entre persas y otomanos, la mitad oriental armenia paso a soberania rusa en el siglo XIX. El colapso zarista y la revolucion bolchevique brindaron la ocasion de proclamar una republica independiente en el Caucaso. Rodeada por la hostilidad otomana al sur, la guerra civil rusa al norte y disputas con vecinos regionales, la nueva nacion lucha por su supervivencia.

column2: The Commonwealth of Australia was formally granted independence on Jan. 1st 1901, joining the British Commonwealth and becoming a staunch ally of Britain. Its fortunes since that time have been mixed, while its economy has grown steadily since independence, it suffered heavy losses during the Great War, suffering the greatest casualties in proportion to total number of troops involved of any of the Allies during the war. Nevertheless, it was through the Great War that the Anzacs (Australian and New Zealand Army Corps) won a reputation for outstanding bravery surpassed by none, serving with distinction in Palestine and Flanders, while forever embedding the peninsula of Gallipoli in Australian folklore. The boom period of the 1920's ended with disaster as the Great Depression ruined Australia's economy and, at its worst, put up to a third of the country's workers out of a job. Yet, despite continued economic problems and a lack of enthusiasm spawned from memories of the Great War, Australia entered the war against Germany on September 3rd 1939 without hesitation. With the world at war again and a new generation ready to fight it, the question remains whether the Anzacs will continue to uphold their reputation as a fighting force equal to any in the world.
column5: Federada en 1901, Australia forjo su identidad militar con el cuerpo ANZAC en Galipoli y el frente occidental durante la Gran Guerra. Pese a que la Gran Depresion causo graves estragos fabriles y desempleo, el gobierno de Canberra declaro la guerra a Alemania en septiembre de 1939 en apoyo de Gran Bretana, movilizando divisiones de voluntarios para los frentes del Imperio.

column2: By june 1941 Australia has been at war for almost two years. The Royal Australian Navy participated in operations against Italy after its entry into the war in June 1940. A few Australians flew in the Battle of Britain in August and September of the same year, but the Australian Army was not engaged in combat until 1941. Australian Army fought in first Greece then Crete and finally in North Africa alongside their Commonwealth allies, where now the Anzacs under siege in Tobruk. Can Tobruk hold until relieved?
column5: Hacia mediados de 1941, las fuerzas terrestres australianas combaten activamente en el Mediterraneo tras campanas en Grecia y Creta. En el norte de Africa, las divisiones del ANZAC defienden con firmeza la fortaleza cercada de Tobruk frente al avance del Eje, mientras en el pais crecen los temores por la amenaza naval y expansionista del Imperio japones en el Pacifico.

column2: Australia has never had to endure foreign soldiers on its own soil. However, during the early days of the Japanese advance in the southern Pacific, that danger was almost palpable. Now, years later, Australia is safe, and it has dispatched its soldiers to the battlefields of Europe and the Pacific alike, fighting on the front lines of North Africa, Italy, New Guinea and countless other conflict zones.
column5: Tras conjurar el peligro de una invasion directa nipona en las duras campanas de Nueva Guinea y el mar del Coral, Australia asegura sus lineas maritimas. Con su territorio a salvo, tropas aeronavales y terrestres australianas combaten en estrecha cooperacion con los Estados Unidos en las operaciones anfibias del Pacifico sudoccidental y en teatros aliados.

column2: The destruction of Hiroshima and Nagasaki sealed the fate of Japan, and the surrender documents were signed on the USS Missouri on September 2nd, 1945 ending six years of war for Australia. The war weary Australian people were not ready for the attack on the Western Allies by the Soviets on October 2nd. Now, Australia faces another World War. What role will Australia play in this clash of Titans?
column5: La capitulacion japonesa a bordo del USS Missouri cerro seis anos de duro esfuerzo belico australiano. No obstante, el estallido inmediato de tensiones globales entre los Aliados occidentales y la Union Sovietica empuja a la exhausta Mancomunidad a reorganizar sus defensas ante un nuevo escenario de confrontacion bipolar.

column5: Nacida como dominio en 1901 y curtida por el elevado coste en vidas del ANZAC en la Primera Guerra Mundial, Australia encara 1936 en lenta recuperacion de la crisis de 1929. Con una industria militar reducida pero firme lealtad a la corona britanica, el pais debe modernizar sus fuerzas armadas y vigilar la creciente tension geopolitica en la cuenca del Pacifico.

column2: After World War One Austria had been reduced to its German core land. On November 12th, 1918, the republic was proclaimed. The provisorical national assembly created a preliminary constitution and appointed a coalition government under the social democrat Karl Renner (1919/20), replacing the previous majory vote system by a system of proportional representation, including suffrage for women. Goal of national assembly and government was the unification with Germany, made impossible, however, by decisions of the war's victors. A constitution declaring Austria a federal state was installed in 1920. In the election held thereafter, the social democrats lost to the conservative Christian Socials who would become the dominating power in Austrian politics in the following years. Their governments, however, didn't succeed in stabilizing the young republic. Before the background of great economic problems the society drifted to the radical lefts (Republican Protection League) and rights (Heimwehr). Several times Austria was on the brink of civil war. A change of the constitution in 1929 to strengthen the role of the president was designed to further stabilize the country. In the early 1930s the Nazis gained support in Austria, too. Conservative Chancellor Engelbert Dollfuß took the Nazi's successes as an opportunity to abolish the constitution and erect an authoritarian regime. After unrests in 1934 Dollfuß banned all parties except his own Vaterländische Front and installed a constitution after fascist rolemodels. He was killed, however, during a coup attempt on July 25th, 1934. His successor, Karl Schuschnigg continued his policy, seeking to settle tensions with Germany and to protect Austria's sovereignty.
column5: Reducida a sus tierras germanas tras 1918, la joven republica austriaca sufrio aguda polarizacion paramilitar entre el Schutzbund socialista y la Heimwehr derechista. Tras la guerra civil de 1934, Dollfuss implanto el austrofascismo corporativo ilegalizando a la oposicion. Tras su asesinato por nazis austriacos, Kurt von Schuschnigg procura defender la soberania frente a la presion de Berlin.

column2: Azerbaijan means 'Land of Fire' in the Persian language, in honour of the petroleum deposits which have been known here since ancient times. Since the 1870s, the oil industry has been massively developed, bringing great prosperity to the region. However, in the political arena things are not so promising. The Azeri people are Muslims, of Turkic origin, but their land has been fought over by Ottomans, Persians and Russians for centuries. In 1828 the Russians finally took control over most of Azerbaijan, and have ruled it ever since. However, the collapse of Russian power following the Revolution has thrust independence on the Azeri people, and presented them with a choice. Some favour joining with the other Caucasus peoples in Georgia and Armenia, creating a Federation to preserve peace. Others decry an alliance with Christians, and instead argue that Azerbaijan should join with their fellow-Turks in the Ottoman Empire. The struggles of the different factions in the Russian Civil War also present both an opportunity and a threat to the Azeris. What should their decision be?
column5: Conocida por sus ricos pozos petroliferos de Baku, explotados industrialmente desde finales del siglo XIX, Azerbaiyan proclamo una republica democratica tras la caida del Imperio zarista. Atrapada entre los tumultos de la guerra civil rusa, las ofensivas del Imperio otomano y la rivalidad con sus vecinos caucasicos, la nacion busca defender su riqueza estrategica y soberania.

column2: Including two distinct linguistic groups, the French and the Flemish, the kingdom of Belgium was created in 1831 in the wake of a rebellion staged by the people of the former Austrian Netherlands against Dutch rule. The first King, Leopold I ruled until 1865, during which Belgium experienced rapid industrialisation, developed a stable domestic arrangement with a constitutional monarchy and a parliamentary government. With French capital, Belgium developed her coal and textile industries, thus reinforcing its status of being one of the most highly modernised and densely populated countries in Europe. Diplomatically, Belgium's neutrality was assured by treaty in 1839, in which the great powers promised to come to her aid if her territorial integrity was violated. This agreement was put to the test in 1870 amidst the Franco-Prussian war, when Prime Minister Gladstone threatened British intervention in the event of either power encroaching on Belgian territory. In the event, Belgium did not feature in either the French or German war plans, but with growing antipathy between those two powers at the turn of the century, Belgium grows unsure as to whether her neutrality will be respected in the next war. This fear has been augmented by Britain's shift in loyalties alongside the French, leaving the Belgians to plan in case of invasion on three sides: fortresses have been built in Liege and Namur to counter German invasion from the east, extra divisions placed in the west to check a possible French invasion, and now a division on the north coast in case of an amphibious British assault. Belgium, mistrustful of those around her, will continue to appeal to the signatories of the 1839 treaty should any power violate her neutrality.
column5: Independizada en 1830 y altamente industrializada gracias a su mineria y siderurgia, Belgica cuenta con su neutralidad perpetua garantizada por el Tratado de Londres de 1839. Ante las crecientes tensiones entre Alemania y Francia, el reino guarnecio los complejos fortificados de Lieja y Namur a lo largo del Mosa para resistir cualquier intento de invasion foranea.

column2: In 1940, Germany invaded Belgium and Holland. As the blitzkrieg swept across the country, the Belgian government evacuated to London. King Leopold III, however, surrendered to the German forces when the Belgian lines were broken and Belgium was occupied. His action incurred the violent disapproval of the Belgian people and brought accusations of treason. Leopold III was held prisoner in the palace of Laeken before being taken to Germany. During the war, the largest known reserves of uranium were in the Belgian Congo. The Belgian company Union Minière du Haut Katanga provided the United States the uranium required by the Manhattan Project. When the British, Canadian, and American armies liberated Belgium at the end of 1944, popular feeling against Leopold III was substantial, and his brother Prince Karel assumed regency. Now, war once again rages across Europe. Will the Allied armies hold? Or will Belgium face occupation yet again?
column5: Ocupada en 1940 tras la capitulacion de Leopoldo III, Belgica mantuvo su gobierno en el exilio en Londres mientras aportaba uranio congolenio al Proyecto Manhattan. Tras su liberacion a fines de 1944, la regencia del principe Carlos y una grave crisis politica en torno a la corona marcan el pais, mientras las fuerzas occidentales intentan consolidar la defensa de Europa occidental.

column2: With World War II rising at the horizon, Belgium is facing grave problems. Being one of the winners of World War I, Belgium was also to receive payments from the German Empire. Those payments never came and the Belgian economy was stagnating. The current, mainly liberal, government of Paul van Zeeland hasn't been able to turn the tide and dissent among the people is rising. Authoritarian & nationalistic parties like the VNV & Rex are quickly gaining votes, and are openly flirting with nazi Germany.
column5: Agotada por las secuelas de la Gran Guerra y el impago de reparaciones, la economia belga afronta un duro estancamiento en 1936. El gobierno de Paul van Zeeland lidia con el ascenso de movimientos autoritarios y fascistas como Rex y el VNV. Ante el rearme aleman, Bruselas abandona los acuerdos militares directos con Francia para retornar a una estricta politica de neutralidad armada.

column2: In 17th century the Lama Ngawang Namgyal who had fled Tibet managed to unify the country and to secure his further conquests through the building of monastery fortresses (Dzongs). The first spiritual and secular ruler of Bhutan, called Shabdung, helped the Drupka Sect to win and transferred the Tibetan governmental system of Dalai Lamas to Bhutan. The Drukpas (Druk = Dragon) gave the country its name - Dragon Land (Druk Yul). The succession of the ruler based on reincarnation. Shabdung Namgyal supposedly seperated the country into three regions which were ruled by princes (Penlop). In 19th century only two of the three houses still were of importance - the Tsonga-Penlops east of the Black Mountains under the Wangchuk family and the Paro-Penlops who govrned almost all of western Bhutan. With the election of the Penlop of Tsonga, Ugyen Wangchuk, on december 17th, 1907, as the first Druk Gyalpo (Dragon king) the Shabdung system was replaced by a hereditary monarchy. Externally, Bhutan came into conflict with the expanding British East India Company who drove the Bhutanese out of the Indian regions of Cooch Behar between 1772 and 1774. 1864/65 Bhutan lost claims to parts of the Bengal and Siamese Plains during the Second British-Bhutanese War. In the Treaty of Punakha 1910 Bhutan formally became a British Protectorate but retained its internal autonomy.
column5: Unificado en el siglo XVII y caracterizado por sus fortalezas monasterio (dzongs), Butan paso del sistema teocratico a una monarquia hereditaria en 1907 bajo Ugyen Wangchuck. Tras perder territorios meridionales ante la expansion imperial de la Compania de las Indias Orientales, el Tratado de Punakha de 1910 coloco sus relaciones exteriores bajo protectorado de Gran Bretana conservando autonomia.

column2: The short-lived Republic of Belarus declared its independence in March 1918, although it fell into the German sphere of control under the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. Following the German defeat in November 1918, the country was promptly occupied by Soviet Russian forces.
column5: La Republica Popular Bielorrusa proclamo su independencia en marzo de 1918 bajo ocupacion del Imperio aleman conforme a Brest-Litovsk. Tras la rendicion alemana en noviembre, el naciente estado colapso de inmediato ante la ofensiva de las fuerzas del Ejercito Rojo, integrando su territorio en la orbita sovietica.

column2: In foreign politics Bolivia has suffered hurtful losses. A border conflict with Chile led to the Saltpetre War 1879 - 1883 which Bolivia lost despite an alliance with Peru. Having to cede the coastal province of Antofagasta in the peace treaty of Valparaiso 1884, the country lost its access to the sea. In 1903 Brazil and Bolivia signed the Treaty of Pétroplis, granting Brazil the important rubber province Acre. A sum of 2 million Pound Sterling didn't compensate the loss. Attempting to secure access to a port in the Chaco War with Paraguay (1932 - 1935) caused the loss of the larger part of the Chaco Boreal region, but at least secured access to the Paraguay river leading to the Atlantic Ocean (finalized in the Treaty of Buenos Aires 1938). Chaco War and the Great Depression brought an end to the positive economic development since 1895 when tin became main export good. In the face of protest movements of the middle class and the mineworkers military governments with state socialist tendencies took over.
column5: Golpeada por la perdida del litoral en la guerra del Pacifico (1879-1883) y de Acre en 1903, Bolivia sufrio otra dura derrota territorial frente a Paraguay en la sangrienta guerra del Chaco (1932-1935). column5: Tras derrocar al Imperio en 1889, la republica federal brasileña consolido un sistema oligarquico dominado por las elites del cafe con leche. El canciller Baron de Rio Branco resolvio favorablemente litigios fronterizos ganando miles de kilometros cuadrados, mientras las fluctuaciones mundiales de los precios del cafe y el caucho marcaban los limites de su desarrollo economico.

column5: La crisis de 1929 destruyo los precios del cafe y desato la revolucion de 1930 liderada por Getulio Vargas con apoyo del movimiento militar de los tenentes. En 1937 Vargas implanto la dictadura corporativista del Estado Novo clausurando el Congreso. Con apoyo financiero y tecnico estadounidense, Brasil impulsa la siderurgia e industria pesada manteniendo una neutralidad pragmatica en 1939.

column2: The Sultanate of Brunei's influence peaked between the 15th and 17th centuries when its control extended over coastal areas of northwest Borneo and the southern Philippines. Brunei subsequently entered a period of decline brought on by internal strife over royal succession, colonial expansion of European powers, and piracy. In 1888, Brunei became a British protectorate.
column5: Tras haber dominado las costas de Borneo y zonas de Filipinas en los siglos XV a XVII, las disputas sucesorias y la intervencion colonial europea diezmaron la influencia del sultanato de Brunei. En 1888, el reino acepto formalmente convertirse en protectorado britanico, quedando la defensa y su diplomacia exterior bajo estricto control de Londres.

column2: Following the preliminary peace of San Stefano after the eighth Russo-Turkish War of 1877/78, the newly formed nation-state of Bulgaria covered Macedonia to the Ochrid Lake as well as a coastal strip on the Aegean Sea. The Berlin Congress of 1878, however, limited Bulgaria's territory to the region between the Danube and Balkans, plus the area around Sofia. Macedonia and Eastern Rumelia remained within the Ottoman Empire. Prince Alexander I was assigned with the task of leading the newly formed principality - Russia, however, keen to exercise control over Bulgaria, watched the successes of Alexander with a great degree of distrust. Alexander annexed Eastern Rumelia in 1885 and defeated Serbia in 1885/86, but was then forced to abdicate after a coup led by pro-Russian officers. His successor, Ferdinand of Saxony-Coburg-Gotha, led Bulgaria to formal independence from the Ottomans and was crowned Tsar in 1908. Motivated by a desire for 'Greater Bulgaria', the country became the driving force behind the Balkans League and carried the majority of the League's burden in the First Balkans War (1912/13). However, during the Second Balkans War of 1913, in which Bulgaria planned to acquire the parts of the Balkans she considered to be populated by Bulgarians, a coalition consisting of Greece, Serbia, Montenegro, Rumania, and the Ottoman Empire defeated Bulgaria. In the peace of Bucharest, Bulgaria lost large parts of her gains from the First Balkans War - Southern Dobrudja went to Rumania, and Adrianople was given to the Ottomans. Of Macedonia, which Bulgaria had demanded in its entirety, they managed to hold onto a small strip of territory in the Pirin Mountains, the rest being parted between Serbia and Greece. Bulgaria had suffered a defeat, but its strong army was still intact and Ferdinand I was waiting for an opportunity to strike back at his neighbouring rivals. However, the Tsar had to contend with strong opposition from within both the army and parliament, which had strongly disapproved of the authoritarian style of Ferdinand's conduct in foreign policy that had already proved so disastrous for Bulgaria.
column5: Pese a soportar el mayor peso de la primera guerra balcanica, la derrota en la segunda guerra balcanica de 1913 frente a sus antiguos aliados despojo a Bulgaria de Dobrudja meridional y la mayor parte de Macedonia. Con un ejercito profesional intacto y un profundo sentimiento de revancha frente a serbios, griegos y rumanos, el zar Fernando I aguarda la ocasion propicia para recuperar sus fronteras.

In 1941 Germany was permitted to march its troops through Bulgaria on their way to the invasion of Yugoslavia. They were granted official rule of Thrace and Macedonia, and later that year, they would declare war on Great Britain and the U.S.A., but not on the USSR.
column5: Adherida al Pacto Tripartito en marzo de 1941, Bulgaria permitio el despliegue del Eje para las invasiones de Yugoslavia y Grecia, recibiendo la administracion de Tracia y Macedonia ademas de Dobrudja meridional. Aunque el zar Boris III declaro la guerra a Gran Bretana y a los Estados Unidos, Sofia evito sistematicamente comprometer sus divisiones en combate contra la Union Sovietica.

column2: When the Red Army reached Bulgaria, they were welcomed by the populace as liberators from German occupation. The presence of the Red Army strengthened immeasurably the communist's dealings with the Allies and rival factions in the new Bulgarian coalition government. The continuation of the war in Europe eight months after Bulgaria's surrender, and the presence of the Red Army, gave the communists time to consolidate power. Now the world is at war again. This time Bulgaria is on the front lines. Will the combined forces of the Red Army and Bulgarian Army liberate Turkey and the Middle East?
column5: La entrada del Ejercito Rojo en septiembre de 1944 desato el golpe del Frente de la Patria y la purga de los elementos monarquicos. Con la ocupacion militar sovietica consolidando a los comunistas en el poder, Bulgaria queda alineada como cabeza de puente de Moscu en los Balcanes frente a Turquia y los mandos aliados de la region.

Condicionada por reclamos irredentistas en Tracia, Dobrudja y Macedonia, Sofia busca aliados internacionales que respalden la revision de los tratados de paz.

column2: Canada saw a quick economic rise through the transcontinental railroad (completed in 1885) as shipping became faster, industrial growth more rapid, and settlement in the West more widespread. The dominion supported Great Britain during the Boer War and World War One, underlining its semi-independent status by signing the Versailles Treaty for itself in 1919 and by receiving her own seat in the League of Nations. Prime Minister William Lyon Mackenzie King (1921 - 1930, 1935 - 1948) from the Liberals demanded for Canada the conduct of an independent foreign policy on the Empire Conference in 1923. With the Balfour declaration on the Empire Conference in 1926 Canada was granted independence and emancipation within the Commonwealth of Nations. The Westminster Statute of 1931 released Canada as an independent state. The Great Depression hit Canada hard after a period of prosperity in the 1920s. The Conservatives rose to power (1930 - 1935) who followed Roosevelt's policy of the New Deal. In 1934 the Bank of Canada was founded. In 1939 the country joined the war against Germany.
column5: Tras la expansion ferroviaria de 1885 y su aporte en la Gran Guerra, Canada afianzo su autonomia firmando el Tratado de Versalles y obteniendo asiento en la Sociedad de Naciones. La Declaracion Balfour de 1926 y el Estatuto de Westminster de 1931 consagraron su plena soberania en la Mancomunidad. Pese a la crisis de 1929, el pais declaro la guerra a Alemania en septiembre de 1939.

column5: Soberana tras el Estatuto de Westminster de 1931, Canada ingreso en el conflicto europeo en 1939 en apoyo de Gran Bretana. Con una marina mercante y una capacidad fabril en plena expansion, Ottawa se convirtio en un bastión logistico y militar clave para sostener las rutas de convoyes atlanticas frente a los submarinos del Eje, antes de extender su esfuerzo bélico al frente del Pacifico.

column2: As a loyal dominion, Canada has stood by the British motherland throughout the last five years, enduring the hardships of war with her and supporting her with equipment, supplies and young men dying on the battlefields of Northern Africa, and now France and Italy. With the failed raid at Dieppe, Canadian soldiers had been the first Allied soldiers after the defeat of France to set foot on the continent, and now, together with British and US forces, the loyal Canadians are back on French soil, ready to carry the fight ever closer to the German Reich and depose Hitler and his Nazi regime.
column5: Durante cinco anos de guerra, Canada ha aportado divisiones, suministros y escoltas de convoyes vitales a la causa aliada. Tras el cruento bautismo de fuego en el asalto a Dieppe en 1942 y los combates en el norte de Africa e Italia, tropas del Primer Ejercito canadiense han desembarcado en Normandia, listas para quebrar las lineas alemanas y avanzar hacia el corazon del Reich.

column2: On May 8, 1945, the Allies accepted German surrender terms at the conclusion of the European conflict of World War II. The destruction of Hiroshima and Nagasaki sealed the fate of Japan, and the surrender documents were signed on the USS Missouri on September 2nd, 1945. Of a population just over eleven million, more than one and a half million Canadians served in the Second World War. By the end of World War II, Canada was the fourth strongest military power in the world, behind only the USA, the USSR, and the UK. This Herculean effort created political strain in Canada. Now with a new war underway, Canada must again rise to the challenge. Will conscription come to the forefront as a political issue again? What role will Canada play in a Eurasian land war?
column5: Concluida la guerra mundial tras la capitulacion de Alemania y Japon, mas de un millon de canadienses se habian movilizado, situando al pais como una de las mayores potencias industriales y militares del bloque aliado. El estallido inmediato de un nuevo conflicto a escala global reabre el debate interno sobre el reclutamiento forzoso y el despliegue expedicionario en Eurasia.
